A chain of AND conditions

questions.q: Does BETWEEN include or exclude its two boundary values?
options: It includes both boundary values (inclusive)
It excludes both boundary values (exclusive)
It includes the lower bound only
It includes the upper bound only
questions.explain: BETWEEN 50 AND 100 is equivalent to >= 50 AND <= 100 — a value of exactly 50 or exactly 100 both match.

questions.q: What does 'WHERE Color NOT IN ('Red', 'Blue')' return?
options: Every row except those with Color equal to Red or Blue
Only rows with Color equal to Red or Blue
A syntax error — NOT IN doesn't exist
Only rows where Color is NULL
questions.explain: NOT IN negates the whole list check, excluding any row matching one of the listed values.

questions.q: Can BETWEEN be used with dates?
options: Yes — WHERE OrderDate BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2013-12-31' works the same way as with numbers
No, BETWEEN only works with numeric columns
Only with the DATEBETWEEN function
Only if the dates are converted to strings first
questions.explain: BETWEEN works on any comparable type, including dates, using the same inclusive-range logic.

questions.q: Is IN a new filtering capability, or shorthand for something else?
options: Shorthand — it doesn't do anything a chain of OR conditions couldn't already do
A completely new capability with no OR equivalent
It can only be used inside a subquery
It replaces WHERE entirely
questions.explain: IN is purely a more readable way to write what would otherwise be a long OR chain against the same column.
